items.headline: Mixed Pre-Market Opening to a Week Focused on Retail Earnings and Fed Outlook
items.summary: U.S. stock futures are showing a mixed performance this Monday, August 17, 2026, as investors prepare for a week dominated by major retail earnings reports and insights from the Federal Reserve's latest meeting minutes. This follows a cautious close on Friday, influenced by weaker-than-expected July retail sales data. Technology stocks, particularly chipmakers, are indicating pre-market strength, bolstered by optimistic forecasts from AI industry leaders. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East continue to be a backdrop for market sentiment, alongside evolving expectations for future interest rate hikes.

items.headline: Tech Sector Shows Pre-market Strength, Consumer Discretionary Eyed
items.summary: Technology stocks, particularly chipmakers, are leading pre-market gains, buoyed by a robust revenue forecast from AI leader Anthropic. This contrasts with last Friday's session, where the information technology and healthcare sectors were among the worst performers in the S&P 500, with weakness noted in chip stocks.

items.headline: July Retail Sales Disappoint, Fed Rate Hike Odds Lowered
items.summary: A surprisingly weak July U.S. retail sales report, showing a 0.6% decline month-on-month (the largest drop since May 2025), has fueled concerns about consumer health and economic growth. This data, alongside soft inflation figures, has led traders to dial back expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in September, with odds falling to roughly 30-33%. The minutes from the Fed's July 28-29 FOMC meeting are scheduled for release on Wednesday, which could offer further insights into monetary policy. Meanwhile, consumer debt saw a slight decline in Q2 2026, though rising Home Equity Lines of Credit (HELOCs) and credit card debt suggest some consumers are facing financial strain. The August Empire State Manufacturing Index and NAHB Housing Market Index data are expected later today.

items.headline: Retail Giants and AI Firms in Focus for Earnings This Week
items.summary: The market is bracing for a busy week of earnings reports from major retail companies, including Walmart ($WMT), Home Depot ($HD), Target ($TGT), and Lowe's ($LOW), which will provide key insights into consumer spending trends. Home Depot is slated to report on Tuesday, followed by Target and Lowe's on Wednesday, and Walmart on Thursday. This morning, H World Group Limited ($HTHT), BitFuFu Inc. ($FUFU) and NDSN ($NDSN) are among the companies reporting earnings pre-market. XP Inc. ($XP) is expected to release its earnings after market close today. Separately, AI leader Anthropic's forecast of strong 2028 revenue (approximately $190 billion to $200 billion) is positively impacting technology stocks.
